title: Five bounded original PC script conditions

conditions.name: PartyUnderCover
conditions.scope: Returns float 1 iff the complete dword at 0x876cc8 is nonzero. Does not compute party cover state.

conditions.name: CannotReachDestination
conditions.scope: Null script creature returns zero; otherwise float 1 iff script-creature +0x1e8 has mask 0x400000. Does not run pathfinding or assign the flag.

conditions.name: RigidAnimFrame
conditions.scope: Static scene linear name resolution initializer to animation pointer; null initialized animation returns float 1; otherwise loads float32 +0x4c. Does not advance frames or implement indexed/dynamic scene resolution.

conditions.name: BuildItComplete
conditions.scope: Initializer uses world registry +0x2ac8 and runtime type global 0x804e44 then 0x55a020 ordered name lookup. Reader follows initialized registry record first word to current target; returns float 1 iff target byte +0x6d is exactly 2. Build creation and completion transitions are external.
conditions.assemblyCorrection: Ghidra initializer pseudocode omits the copied type selector dword read at 0x4415e8 from 0x804e44. Original assembly explicitly writes it to the tail-call second argument at esp+8.

conditions.name: IsSetAlive
conditions.scope: Shared NumInSetAlive initializer returns literal selectors 1..16, -1 for case-insensitive myset, otherwise 0; decimal-prefix parsing wraps int32. Reader converts selected global byte presence to float 0/1, unlike NumInSetAlive count reader. myset replaces -1 with script packet byte +0xb0.

verification.managedCompilation: Core and saved-fixture harness compiled independently with Framework csc.
verification.managedExecution: Pending: newly generated executable launch returned spawn EPERM.

limits: Native tests execute original bytes in isolated Unicorn x86 memory, not the Windows game.
World state producers, object/reference lifetime and build state transitions are external.
Build registry name-accessor callback maps synthetic fixture records to names; generic lookup and predicates remain native.
Rigid scene contract supports static linear lookup only, excludes 0x5cf510 accelerated/dynamic resolver.
Finite float32 frame values including signed zero and subnormals; signaling NaN exception/payload behavior excluded.
Only ASCII names/operands in portable source.
Alive byte table synthetic backing covers all packet byte indices and establishes no actual table allocation size.
Prepared registry type slot at type==count must exist: original lookup takes indexed path for equality.
Script loader/source reachability is not established by exercising preserved source occurrences.
